notes: The measurement was taken in the development checkout, which is shared with ten agent sessions: the load average was 34–50, so the absolute numbers are an upper bound and the ratios between the phases are the fact.

These numbers were measured with the commands the tool ran BEFORE it was corrected, and the tool now measures different ones — so this record is a history, not a current price: the `together` phase was measured with `--parallel`, which the verdict never passes, and the `digest` phase measured `git ls-files` only, while the verdict hashes every Kotlin file with `git hash-object` as well.

The `auto-correct` number was obtained by running a CORRECTING detekt in the shared development checkout. The tool now runs that correction in a throwaway copy of the tree and refuses to correct the tree you are working in, so this number will not be reproduced the same way.
Re-measure with `python3 scripts/measure-verdict-cost.py` to publish a price of the commands the tool measures now.

phases.name: detekt
phases.what: the analysis the verdict waits for — `:shared:detekt`, read-only

phases.name: auto-correct
phases.note: measured by running a correcting detekt in the shared development checkout; the tool now corrects a throwaway copy and refuses to correct the tree you are working in
phases.what: the same run with `--auto-correct` — what the verdict deliberately does not do, because it reads the tree it judges

phases.name: digest
phases.note: measured with `git ls-files` only; the verdict's digest also runs `git hash-object` over every Kotlin file, and the tool now measures the whole digest
phases.what: the content digest the verdict computes before and after the analysis — measured here with `git ls-files` only, which is HALF of the verdict's digest (`git ls-files` plus `git hash-object` over every Kotlin file)

phases.name: together
phases.note: the global `./gw` slots were already taken, so the two modules were serialised — parallelism was not available on this host; the command also carries `--parallel`, which the verdict does not pass, and the tool now measures the verdict's own invocation
phases.what: `:shared:detekt` and `:desktopApp:detekt` judged in ONE Gradle invocation — measured with `--parallel`, which the verdict never passes; the tool now measures the invocation the verdict makes

staleReason: the tool now measures `digest` with a different command (git ls-files -- *.kt *.kts && git ls-files --others --exclude-standard -- *.kt *.kts && git hash-object --stdin-paths); the record was measured with git ls-files -- *.kt *.kts; the tool now measures `together` with a different command (./gw :shared:detekt :desktopApp:detekt --rerun --continue --no-daemon --console=plain); the record was measured with ./gw :shared:detekt :desktopApp:detekt --parallel --rerun --continue --no-daemon --console=plain
